title: Sean
creator: CrossFit
description: Ten rounds of 11 chest-to-bar pull-ups and 22 front squats with a light bar, for time. Honours U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Sean M. Flannery, killed by an IED in Kandahar Province, Afghanistan, in 2010. 220 front squats: the bar is light on purpose.
